title: Wall-crossing, Hitchin systems, and the WKB approximation
note: Adv. Math. 234 (2013), 239-403; arXiv:0907.3987v2. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1016/j.aim.2012.09.027) and arXiv e-print source (2026-11-28). Constructs WKB ideal triangulations of punctured Riemann surfaces from quadratic differentials, identifies Fock-Goncharov cluster coordinates with WKB periods, and proves flips/jugglings across BPS walls induce Kontsevich-Soibelman / dilogarithm Stokes symplectomorphisms (Sections 5-7, 11).
